title: Candidate PixelLab operations for the representative sample: shortlist from DATED documentation, not discovery

basis.what_the_catalog_supplies: tool name, category, effect, required argument names and poll tool only. It supplies no inputSchema, no size ranges, no image-input fields, no output packaging, no price and no entitlement.
basis.what_it_cannot_do: It cannot select a tool, cannot be used as the schema for pixl_job_prepare, and cannot establish that any listed name is callable in the host that eventually runs this request. Every row below is a question for the live declaration, not a finding.

deliverable_being_matched: One static 32 x 32 side-view sprite with binary alpha, outlined as reference.png, conditioned on reference.png as the style anchor (see sample-creative-brief.json). Selection follows pixl-kit/skills/pixl/references/pixellab-operations.md: choose by required reference roles, native dimensions, output structure and integration target, not by keyword.

plausible_operations.name: create_image_pro
plausible_operations.why_plausible: Freeform single-image generation; the operations reference names Pro/Pro Flash as the route where style-image conditioning and native sizes matter for a small standalone sprite.
discriminating_questions_for_the_live_de: Does its inputSchema expose a fixed output size, and is 32 x 32 an allowed value (field names, enum or min/max)?

Which field carries style reference images, how many does it accept, and by what transport (upload handle from get_upload_url, URL, base64, owned asset ID)? Is the style anchor distinct from an init/content image?
Does it offer a transparent-background / alpha control, and does the documentation say whether the alpha is binary or may be fractional?
How many images does one call return (single image vs candidate grid), and can the count be set to 1?

plausible_operations.name: create_image_pixflux
plausible_operations.why_plausible: Freeform single-image generation listed beside Pixen and Pro; the right one depends on which accepts a 32 x 32 canvas together with an actual style image.
discriminating_questions_for_the_live_de: Style image input: present, how many, which transport?
Transparent background / alpha control and its nature (binary or fractional)?
Parameter-level controls for outline, shading and detail that could carry components 1-3 of the intent without relying on prose alone?

plausible_operations.name: create_image_pixen
plausible_operations.why_plausible: Same class as the two above.
discriminating_questions_for_the_live_de: Same four questions as create_image_pixflux; additionally whether Pixen targets a native-pixel grid at 32 x 32 or renders larger and downsamples (which would conflict with the nearest-sampling and no-anti-aliasing intent).

plausible_operations.name: create_character
plausible_operations.why_plausible: The deliverable is a character and the family will later need identity continuity (scout, medic) and possibly animation (i_animation unresolved); a character resource could carry identity across later members.
discriminating_questions_for_the_live_de: Does character creation force a direction set (4/8 directions), a template/canvas size, or an animation packaging that exceeds the single static 32 x 32 side-view sprite planned for f_sample?

Can exactly one side-facing static frame be obtained at exactly 32 x 32 with binary alpha, or would it require cropping/resizing a larger sheet (which is a derived candidate, not the generated bytes)?
Does it accept style reference images at all, and in which field?
Does the returned resource expose the frame bytes for download so the candidate can be imported with its own hash?
plausible_operations.note: Choosing this for the sample would be justified only if the live declaration shows it fits the sample contract; later family needs do not by themselves justify a larger deliverable now.

plausible_operations.name: create_1_direction_object
plausible_operations.why_plausible: The only cached row whose required list names style_images, so it demonstrably takes a style reference; it produces one direction, matching the single facing of the sample.
discriminating_questions_for_the_live_de: Is 'object' semantics acceptable for a character sprite in this operation, or does it steer toward props?
What size control and alpha behaviour does it declare?
How many style_images does it accept and by what transport?
Output count and download route via get_object.

post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.name: edit_image
post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.use: targeted repair of a nearly correct candidate while preserving identity; produces a new candidate that must be reviewed anew

post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.name: inpaint_image
post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.use: region repair with mask semantics to be read from the live schema

post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.name: reduce_colors
post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.use: only if a candidate fails q_sample_palette by stray colours and the owner's style is otherwise met; the result is a different candidate

post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.name: correct_pixelart
post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.use: grid/cluster cleanup; must not be used to erase the authored outline weight

post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.name: get_image / get_character / get_object
post_processing_only_not_for_first_gener.use: poll and retrieve for the chosen family of operations; the poll tool is named per row in the catalog

not_applicable_to_this_deliverable: image_to_pixelart, unzoom_image (no source raster to convert)
animate_image, animate_image_pixminimax, animate_character, animate_object (i_animation unresolved; the sample is static by plan)
create_8_direction_object, create_character_state (more directions/states than the sample needs)
all tileset, tiles_pro, path/building kit, map, UI asset, font, portrait, vocal/lip-sync, chat, sandbox, agent_* and project-management tools
supporting_discovery_calls_to_make_first: the host's tool listing for the authenticated PixelLab MCP connection (actual names and inputSchema objects)

get_upload_url (if present) for transporting reference.png bytes; bind the returned handle to sha256 d997cadefc6b94c1c14f4ec17159deaf5ceb7ea9543b2522390ea1a577470aa7 and role 'style' in the reviewed request
get_balance / any quote capability, read as provisional; a cached price or inventory establishes no entitlement
search_knowledge or agent_help only as documentation pointers, never as a substitute for the declaration
decision_rule: Pick the operation whose live declaration answers yes to: fixed 32 x 32 output, at least one actual style-image input with a usable transport, transparent output, single-image (or count=1) packaging. If no operation satisfies all four, report the mismatch with the viable staged path (for example generate at the nearest supported size and treat any resize as a derived candidate requiring its own review) rather than silently changing the contract.
